The Health Care Equipment & Services sub-sector has a weight of 50% and a % change of 1.38%, while Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences has a weight of 50% and a % change of 0.09%. The overall All Sectors index has a % change of 0.62% on the same date. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to any specific question beyond these figures.
